description: Combine the fastest tiled n=352 solver with the remotely accepted guarded n=176 implementation: preserve each size-specialized kernel, reconcile shared extension and dispatch code, add residual and orthogonality certification with selective portable Xsyev fallback for both custom sizes, and stress diverse n=176/n=352 spectra before profiling the integrated path.

Updated the n352 panel and norm reductions to the accepted parent's leader-only block reduction helper. NVCC then exposed one remaining old block_sum call in the global reducer's rank-2 correction reduction; that total is likewise consumed only by thread 0.

Completed the shared-helper integration. The separate n176 16x8/column-reflector and n352 32x4/row-reflector solver instantiations pass all 39 official tests with per-matrix selective Xsyev repair. Full metric is 47667.180 us; n176 is 1078.851 us and n352 is 30830.472 us, showing the integrated n176 path is retained while the n352 certificate/integration path needs profiling against its 43973.713-us parent.

All 39 tests pass; n176 is 1078.731 us and n352 returns to the custom path at 9840.952 us including certification. Kept the two library bmm products but fused residual formation, diagonal subtraction, exact column-L1 reductions, finite checks, value scaling, and per-matrix/global flagging into one 256-thread CUDA block per matrix. All 39 tests pass. N176 improves from 1078.731 to 1014.666 us; n352 measures 10001.788 us versus 9840.952 for the PyTorch reduction chain. Aggregate is 43552.859 us, with unrelated n2048 variance.

Launch the exact fused certificate with 512 threads at n352 so every column is handled concurrently, retaining 256 threads at n176. All official tests pass. N352 improves from 10001.788 to 9880.911 us; n176 is statistically unchanged at 1017.228 us. Aggregate measures 43511.986 us.

Partition n352 certificate columns across two 256-thread CTAs per matrix, each redundantly reducing the eigenvalue scale but atomically sharing exact unsafe flags; n176 remains one CTA. All tests pass. N352 improves from 9880.911 to 9772.944 us and n176 measures 992.878 us; aggregate reaches 43374.001 us.

Balance n352 certification across three 128-thread partitions covering 128/128/96 columns and 120 CTAs, while retaining n176's one 256-thread block. All tests pass. N352 improves from 9772.944 to 9720.203 us; n176 is stable at 992.369 us. Aggregate measures 43383.252 us because unrelated shapes vary.

Cache the exact certificate's Gram, AQ, and flag tensors per device/batch/size and fill them through at::bmm_out, removing repeated product-buffer allocation while retaining identical math and flags. All tests pass. N176 is 988.054 us, n352 9757.878 us (within noise of 992.369/9720.203), and aggregate measures 43336.047 us.
